content: GTA VI earned $3.79 billion in its first day of sales, which set “a new record for entertainment across any medium,” according to an announcement from Rockstar Games. The game also sold 32.5 million preorder copies. “It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI,” Sam Houser, Rockstar’s president and founder, said in a statement. “We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you.” Rockstar claims that the game’s release, which happened Thursday, was “the biggest entertainment launch in history.” The news follows leaks, delays, and a huge amount of interest ahead of GTA VI’s launch. (Many other games steered clear of GTA VI to get their time in the sun.) But even with the weight of anticipation placed upon GTA VI, it actually lived up to the hype, my colleague Andrew Webster said in his review.
